originalTitle: Dow Jones Futures, Oracle Jumps After Oil Prices, Yields Surge; CPI Inflation Due
summary: The S&P 500 undercut its 50-day as Treasury yields and oil prices surged. Oracle jumped late on earnings. The CPI inflation report could lock in expectations for a Fed rate hike next week.
content: The S&P 500 undercut its 50-day as Treasury yields and oil prices surged. Oracle jumped late on earnings. The CPI inflation report could lock in expectations for a Fed rate hike next week.
chineseTitle: 道琼斯期货、甲骨文在油价上涨和收益率飙升后上涨；消费者物价指数 (CPI) 通胀到期
chineseSummary: 随着美国国债收益率和油价飙升，标准普尔 500 指数跌破 50 天指数。甲骨文的财报较晚上涨。 CPI通胀报告可能锁定美联储下周加息的预期。
chineseContent: 随着美国国债收益率和油价飙升，标准普尔 500 指数跌破 50 天指数。甲骨文的财报较晚上涨。 CPI通胀报告可能锁定美联储下周加息的预期。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
